title: TITAN-VIBE: Virtual Intact Block Extraction for periodic reconstruction
description: TITAN-VIBE 1.0.3: faster framewise reconstruction; candidates are checked in the lattice gauge that placed them; frame status, warm start and rescue paths follow the contact assessment of the selected placement; optional evidence-relation export. Includes a Windows x86-64 executable, the buildable TITAN host source with HoloLift omitted, the focused VIBE library, and replay drivers. Every option of 1.0.2 is kept. Release checks and input/output provenance are included.
